reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Chris Dixon, a general partner at Andreessen Horowitz.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Chris Dixon, a general partner at Andreessen Horowitz. Chris is a prolific investor and thinker, having been an entrepreneur, angel investor. Our conversation focuses on Chris's overall thesis for investing in the cryptocurrency space, the opportunities and limitations of blockchain applications.

key_points.text: Chris is a prolific investor and thinker, having been an entrepreneur, angel investor.
Our conversation focuses on Chris's overall thesis for investing in the cryptocurrency space, the opportunities and limitations of blockchain applications.
What's exciting to me is blockchain technology's ability to help us re-imagine old business models and catapult them into the 21st century – and we cover a lot of them..
